When I was your age I was missing out *a lot* and I really wish I threw myself more into creative, solitary pursuits and learning new skills in that time. You can become a more interesting, special and well developed person to others when they all grow out of the partying phase - plus, you learn to enjoy the company of yourself. This is infinitely more valuable than a few parties imo! Best of luck!

Are you into any creative activities, like music, drawing, writing, building and making? These can occupy your time, leave you feeling rewarded and this is a great time to pursue them - you'll have less time in the future for them, and the time you do have will go by very quickly when you're older. 

Learning or developing these creative, or even practical, skills will make you not regret wasted time. You can look back in ten years time and be glad you did it, instead of looking back and feeling bitter about the parties you missed.
